BiblicalUsage: Bedeiah means "servant of Jehovah." He was an Israelite exile who took a foreign woman. You will find it in Ezra 10:35.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Bedeiah is worth remembering, even when little else is told — God counts His people one by one.
